title: Test-Time Scaling for Scientific Equation Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2608.28660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves language model reasoning by allocating additional test-time compute, but prior work mainly studies closed-ended tasks such as math and coding. We study TTS for automated equation discovery, an open-ended setting where models search over candidate equations and rely on observed datapoints for feedback. We formulate LLM-driven equation discovery as an iterative search process that unifies Best-of-N, sequential refinement, tree search, and evolution-style methods under a common compute-allocation view. To isolate allocation effects from prompt engineering and other heuristics, we compare minimal parallel controllers under fixed budgets. On LLM-SRBench equation-discovery tasks, we find that search width is the dominant allocation parameter: the best width in our sweep generally increases with the compute budget, while the population--branching split and controller choice matter less. translated_title: 面向科学方程发现的测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过在推理阶段分配额外的计算资源来提升语言模型的推理能力，但先前的工作主要研究数学和编程等封闭式任务。我们研究了测试时扩展在自动方程发现这一开放式场景中的应用，在该场景中模型需要在候选方程中进行搜索，并依赖观测数据点作为反馈。我们将基于大语言模型的方程发现形式化为一个迭代搜索过程，在统一的计算分配视角下整合了Best-of-N、序列化改进、树搜索和进化式方法。为了将计算分配效应与提示工程及其他启发式技巧隔离开来，我们在固定预算下比较了最简化的并行控制器。在LLM-SRBench方程发现任务上，我们发现搜索宽度是主导性的分配参数：在我们扫描的范围内，最佳宽度通常随计算预算的增加而增大，而种群与分支的划分比例以及控制器的选择则影响较小。适当的宽度选择……
tldr: 该论文首次将测试时扩展研究拓展到开放式科学方程发现任务，提出了统一的迭代搜索计算分配框架，并通过实验发现搜索宽度是影响方程发现性能的最关键分配参数。
en_tdlr: This paper extends test-time scaling to open-ended scientific equation discovery by formulating LLM-driven equation discovery as a unified iterative search framework, and finds that search width is the dominant compute-allocation parameter.
